# short-form-script-benchmark

> An open benchmark for AI models writing 30 to 60 second voiceover scripts for TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Reels: 16 topics as
> creator briefs and as one-line asks, the prompts, a 14-criterion rubric, the checks code runs, the scoring code and a runner
> with a spending cap. Method only: results are not published here yet. Code MIT, data CC BY 4.0.

- [README](https://github.com/viewgum/short-form-script-benchmark/blob/main/README.md): the method, how to run it and what it does not measure
- [briefs/](https://github.com/viewgum/short-form-script-benchmark/tree/main/briefs): the topics
- [method/published-method.json](https://github.com/viewgum/short-form-script-benchmark/blob/main/method/published-method.json): rubric and checks
- [CHANGES.md](https://github.com/viewgum/short-form-script-benchmark/blob/main/CHANGES.md): method changes, dated

## Related

- [skills](https://github.com/viewgum/skills): hook-check grades a hook on five of its criteria and short-form-script runs its five code checks, inside an agent
